items.title: Support / Donate
items.body: A new Settings entry to support FloatNative's development.

items.title: Sleep Timer
items.body: Pause playback automatically after a chosen duration. Settings → Playback.

items.title: Force Landscape
items.body: Lock to landscape from the player even when the system rotation lock is on.

items.title: Playback Speed Sticks
items.body: Your chosen playback speed now carries from one video to the next. Apple TV gets its own Speed menu, too.

items.title: Smoother Fullscreen Return
items.body: Rotating back to portrait — or tapping the close button in fullscreen — no longer pauses playback.
